name: Postmark
description: Postmark is a transactional email API and SMTP service built for developers, focused on fast, reliable delivery, and has delivered billions of emails since 2010.
best_for: Startups and bootstrapped founders, agencies managing client communications, developers seeking straightforward integration, and companies migrating from competitors like SendGrid, Mailgun, or Amazon SES.
features: Email API and SMTP service for flexible integration
Message Streams technology separating transactional and promotional email to protect deliverability
Prebuilt email templates for rapid deployment
Inbound email handling and webhooks for event tracking
Support for multiple languages including Node.js, Python, Ruby, PHP, and C#

tiers.name: Free Developer
tiers.notes: 100 free test/transactional emails per month with full API access.

tiers.name: 10k Emails
tiers.notes: Includes 10,000 emails/month; $1.80 per 1,000 additional emails; 45-day full content retention.

pros: Dedicated Message Streams architecture physically separating transactional triggers from broadcast marketing to maximize deliverability
45-day searchable message retention including full MIME bodies and raw SMTP server transaction logs
Sub-second email delivery speeds with transparent live status feeds and detailed webhook event streams
cons: Higher per-email cost compared to bare-metal infrastructure relays like Amazon SES
Dedicated IP addresses require an additional $50/month add-on fee
Visual drag-and-drop marketing campaign builders are more limited than full-suite ESPs

alternatives.name: SendGrid
alternatives.description: An email API and SMTP service, operated by Twilio, for high-volume transactional and marketing email.
alternatives.best_for: Companies wanting a single email provider handling both high-volume transactional mail and marketing campaigns.

alternatives.name: Brevo
alternatives.description: All-in-one messaging platform providing transactional email API, SMS, WhatsApp, and marketing automation.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses needing multi-channel communication alongside transactional emails with generous free daily limits.
